column1: # Lemurian ship departure: the party leaves Gondowan and sets course for Lemuria.

column3: We're leaving Gondowan!\nReally leaving it!\n...I think I'm ready.{end_wait}
No chart tells us\nwhere this ship will\nlead. We'll find out.{end_wait}
When I left Imil,\nI hoped to be useful.\nI never imagined this.{end_wait}
If we find {actor_name:6},\ndo you think we\ncan go home?{end_now}
I hope so.\nI've missed Vale\nmore than I thought.{end_wait}
Then I guess we\nhave more road ahead.\nOr sea.{end_wait}
Babi spent a lifetime\nlooking for that place.\nI want to see it.{end_wait}
Should we find\n{actor_name:6} before we sail\nto Lemuria?{end_now}
Then we'll try both.\nWe won't abandon\n{actor_name:6} or Babi.{end_wait}
It's an old ship.\nThe sea may have\nchanged since it sailed.{end_wait}
Kraden wanted me\nto see the sea.\nHe left out the waves!{end_wait}
Look at those waves.\nAre we certain\nthis ship can take them?{end_now}
I trust you.\nStill, we'll watch\nthe weather closely.{end_wait}
At least you're\nthinking of the risks.\nWe'll manage together.{end_wait}
{actor_name:6} is out there.\nWe won't leave her\nbehind.{end_wait}
